## About
Vicari Motors works exclusively on late model BMW automobiles. That focus means we handle anything your BMW needs, from basic service, tires and glass repair to advanced diagnostics and full system maintenance and repairs, all done with factory equipment.
We know car repair isn't fun or convenient for most people, so we try to make it as easy as we can. Customers often mention Steve by name, and many say we take the time to go over everything so there are no surprises.
Drivers rate us 4.4 from 58 Google reviews. Stop by the shop on Route 202 in Branchburg or give us a call.

## Services
- Preventative maintenance: Routine service options to keep your BMW healthy and in good condition.
- Diagnostics and repairs: Advanced diagnostics and full system maintenance and repairs using factory equipment.
- Tires and wheels: Wheel and tire installation, including snow tires.
- Oil service: Oil changes and oil service for your BMW.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on cars other than BMW?
A: No. We work only on late model BMW automobiles.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 9:30 to 12:30.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes, we have a night drop available.
